Teaching Staff

Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications has persisted in implementing the strategy of strengthening the school by talents, strengthening the construction of teaching staff, expanding the ranks of talents, and constantly optimizing the structure of teachers. At present, Bei post has a strong team of teachers with the innovation research group of the National Natural Science Foundation of China, the innovation team of "the Yangtze River scholar and the innovation team development plan", the national class teacher, the "thousand man program" and the "100 million talent project in the new century" as the main body. Among the high-level talents, there are 8 members of the academician (including double recruits and foreign academicians), 5 experts from the national Millennium Program, 6 professors of the Yangtze River scholar, 3 young scholars of the Yangtze River scholar, 8 National candidates for the 100 million talent project in the new century, 2 National Class Teachers, and the
